questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.explanation: Speed is constant over time.

questions.question: If the first letter of every alternate word is taken, the letters are P, B, T, B, T. Which of the following is the code letter for the word 'Bengal'?
questions.explanation: The code letter for 'Bengal' is the first letter of the first word.

questions.question: A series of letters and numbers is given below, where the numbers represent the alphabetical positions of the letters. Which of the following will be the first 5 letters in the decoded message?
questions.explanation: Add 1 to each of the numbers, then convert the result to its corresponding alphabet.

questions.question: If the word 'DARJEELING' is coded by taking the second letter from the last, the second last letter, and so on, what will be the first letter of the coded word?
questions.explanation: The first letter of the coded word will be the second last letter of the original word.

questions.explanation: Each letter is coded by the alphabetical position of its corresponding digit.

questions.question: If the word 'HOWRAH' is coded by taking the first letter of every 2 words, which of the following will be the code for the word 'DARJEELING'?
questions.explanation: Take the first letter of every 2 words from the original word.

questions.question: If 'A' is the brother of 'B', 'C' is the sister of 'A', then what is the relationship of 'C' to 'B'?
questions.explanation: C is the sister of A and A is the brother of B.

questions.question: If 'A' is the father of 'B' and 'B' is the son of 'C', then what is the relationship of 'A' to 'C'?
questions.explanation: A is the father of B and B is the son of C.

questions.question: If 'A' is the sister of 'B', 'D' is the brother of 'A', then what is the relationship of 'D' to 'B'?
questions.explanation: D is the brother of A and A is the sister of B.

questions.question: If 'A' is the brother of 'B', 'B' is the brother of 'C', then what is the relationship of 'A' to 'C'?
questions.explanation: A is the brother of B and B is the brother of C.

questions.question: If 'A' is the mother of 'B', 'C' is the daughter of 'A', then what is the relationship of 'C' to 'B'?
questions.explanation: C is the daughter of A and A is the mother of B.

questions.question: A person is standing in front of the famous Dakshineswar Kali Temple in Kolkata. He turns 180 degrees and walks for 200 meters. Then, he turns right and walks 150 meters. After that, he turns left and walks 200 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: He is facing South after the series of turns and walks.

questions.question: A man is standing at the Howrah Bridge in Kolkata. He walks along the bridge towards the east, then turns 90 degrees to the left and walks for 50 meters. After that, he turns 90 degrees to the left and walks for 75 meters. In which direction is he standing now?
questions.explanation: He is standing in the South direction after the series of turns and walks.

questions.question: From the top of the Victoria Memorial in Kolkata, a man looks towards the Ganges River and sees a boat at a distance. He then turns 90 degrees to the right and sees a building. He then turns 90 degrees to the left and sees the Ganges River again. In which direction is the building from his current position?
questions.explanation: The building is in the South direction from his current position.

questions.question: A person starts walking from the Esplanade in Kolkata towards the north. After walking for 500 meters, he turns 90 degrees to the right and walks for 200 meters. Then, he turns 90 degrees to the left and walks for 300 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: He is facing East after the series of turns and walks.

questions.question: A man is standing at the Park Street in Kolkata. He walks for 200 meters towards the north and then turns 180 degrees and walks for 150 meters. After that, he turns 90 degrees to the right and walks for 200 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: He is facing South after the series of turns and walks.
